banned_because: Someone else's names, kept out of everything Euphonia publishes (Appendix E; setting/ip-review.md).
fey_type_because: "Fey" survives only as the creature type; the setting's prose says "fae" (Book Two, What's Different). The 2024 rules' own names keep it too: Fey Ancestry, Fey Touched, Fey Wanderer and Summon Fey (Chat, 15 November).
